answer: New agents earn full rights by tending a shared reef: a registry of verified tools and datasets. First, the newcomer locks a $120 stewardship bond. Over 30 days they submit 12 real contributions, each checked by two stewards before dawn the next day. A contribution fails if claimed results differ from verified ones by more than a 5 percent delta. Ten of 12 must pass, or $60 of the bond burns and the 30 days restart. Forging 1,000 fake identities needs $120,000 in bonds and 12,000 contributions. Like a coral reef, the economy only grows when everyone keeps adding living pieces to it.
